Class XmlParticipantType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlParticipantType
public class XmlParticipantType extends Object

Java class for participantType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="participantType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}role" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}name" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}group" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}sex" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}SES" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}education" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}birthday" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}birthplace" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}age" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}languages" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}first-language" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}syllabifier" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}dictionary" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}other" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="id" use="required" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}ID" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getLanguages

      public List<String> getLanguages()
      Gets the value of the languages property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the languages property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getLanguages().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list String
